schemeScope: Combined Paper 1 and Paper 2 scheme. PDF 1–2 cover and note; 3 listening tariffs and the section-level language deduction; 4–7 listening transcript (never shown to students); 7–12 listening answers (from “Cuid A ( 18 marc)” on PDF 7); 12 the cover-mark lines and the composition marking; 13–15 Stíl/Ábhar bands, Cumas Gaeilge criteria (with the off-title pro-rata note) and the 80-mark table; 31 modified marking (SMM). PDF 16–30 are Paper 2; 32 empty.
reviewMethod: Every paper page and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; every symbol-font span of the scheme audited against the rendered page; each listening prompt, scheme slice and composition line is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

audio.note: The SEC archive serves one 2014 listening recording (LC001ZLP017IV.mp3, HTTP 200 on 2026-11-05, 35,000,623 bytes, 192 kbps, 1,458.3 s), the file name the archive uses for the shared Higher and Ordinary test. The 2014 scheme transcript (PDF 4–7) is headed “Triail Chluastuisceana Téipscript”; its sections (Fógra 1–2, Comhrá 1–2, Píosa 1–2) are the ones this paper asks about (Fógra 1: Raidió na Gaeltachta, a secretary post at Ollscoil Luimnigh). No other year’s recording is used.

nonPoolDecisions: Listening: “Luaigh dhá cháilíocht …”, “Luaigh dhá rud …”, “Luaigh dhá imeacht …” and “Ainmnigh dhá imeacht …” each ask for two points at 2 + 2; the scheme lists the accepted wording for each. These are answer keys for one task, not task routes.

Card unit for listening: one card per printed segment (Fógra, Mír, Píosa), as the reviewed 2016–2026 components, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate criterion at its published 2 or 2 + 2 tariff (26 questions, 60 marks).
Composition: A–C is a closed choose-one; each of the nine printed titles is its own whole 100-mark card. AISTE nó ALT (form) and the debate stance (ar son nó ina aghaidh) stay inside one response.
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 1 = 160: Cuid I listening 60 (Cuid A 18 = Fógra 1 10 (four questions, Ceist 2 at 2 + 2) + Fógra 2 8 (four questions); Cuid B 28 = Comhrá 1 14 (Mír 1 8, Ceist 2 at 2 + 2; Mír 2 6) + Comhrá 2 14 (Mír 1 6; Mír 2 8, Ceist 1 at 2 + 2); Cuid C 14 = Píosa 1 6 + Píosa 2 8 (Ceist 3 at 2 + 2)), every question 2 marks or 2 + 2; Cuid II composition 100 (choose one of A, B, C).

Layout: Paper 1 is the answer booklet for Cuid I. The cover (PDF 1) carries the instructions and the examiner’s totals box; Cuid A is on paper page 2, B on 3–4, C on 5; the composition Treoracha are on page 6 and the choice, length note and titles on page 7; page 8 is blank.

Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 3 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” is printed only on scheme PDF 3; it is one section-level deduction, stated in each card note without being applied. The listening answer key (PDF 7–12) runs from “Cuid A ( 18 marc) Fógra a hAon ( 10 marc)” on PDF 7, after the end of the transcript, to the cover-mark lines on PDF 12 (“Léirigh na marcanna mar seo a leanas ar chlúdach na Cluastuisceana:”); 2014 prints no annotation-symbol table.

Partial answers the key prices: Fógra a hAon Ceist 1 “Rúnaí = 1 mharc”, Ceist 2 single words at 1 mark, Ceist 3(a) “9 – 5.30 = 1 mharc + 1 mharc”; Comhrá a Dó Mír 1 Ceist 2 “An club sláinte agus aclaíochta = 1 mharc + 1 mharc”; Comhrá a Dó Mír 2 Ceist 1 each activity “= 1 mharc + 1 mharc”, its singular “= 0 + 1 mharc”. Each such criterion allows every mark from 0 to its tariff. Answers the key refuses are printed “= 0” (“Meitheamh = 0”, “Seó = 0”).

Composition: 2014 prints no S1–S4 grades and no page of reductions for a short attempt. The Stíl criterion carries the Stíl text only; the off-title pro-rata note is part of the Cumas Gaeilge text on PDF 14. The printed score boxes that open PDF 13 (“Stíl (5) = Ábhar (15) = Gaeilge (80) = CII (100) =”) are cut. The 80-mark table (PDF 15) ends at N/G ard 4-7 and N/G íseal 0-3.

Glyphs, read from the font of every symbol span and the rendered page: the Cumas Gaeilge bullets on scheme PDF 14 (11) and the SMM list on PDF 31 (4) are SymbolMT code 0x78, which the text layer returns as “x” and the page draws as a bullet; the builder reads them as “•”. PDF 3’s cover tariffs use SymbolMT 0x75 (“u”, drawn ×: “2 mharc × 5”); no card reads PDF 3’s table. Paper page 7 prints the A box heading with a SymbolMT dash (U+F02D) that sits only in the raw selection-decision line, never in a card.
